definitions.explanation: A prefecture east of Tokyo across Tokyo Bay, and its capital city. Home to Narita Airport and Tokyo Disney Resort.

examples.japanese: {千葉|ちば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
{成田空港|なりたくうこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{千葉県|ちばけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Narita Airport is in Chiba Prefecture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧ディズニーランド⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}って→違う：01957_chigau⟧{千葉|ちば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Despite its name, Tokyo Disneyland is actually in Chiba.

notes:
Many residents commute into Tokyo, so {千葉|ちば} is often grouped with ⟦{埼玉|さいたま}→埼玉：31336_saitama⟧ and ⟦{神奈川|かながわ}→神奈川：31335_kanagawa⟧ as the Tokyo commuter belt.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {千葉県|ちばけん}: Chiba Prefecture
- {千葉市|ちばし}: Chiba City
- {房総半島|ぼうそうはんとう}: the Boso Peninsula (most of the prefecture)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Narita Airport and Tokyo Disney Resort both carry Tokyo's name but stand in {千葉|ちば}, a standing joke among its residents.
